title: Mileage Schedule for Route Pickups of Northgate Purchases & Returns Business Special Orders
content:
This mileage schedule applies to the route pickup fee that Northgate Purchases & Returns invoices for the changed-mind freight pickup of special-order merchandise on a Northgate Business Membership or Northgate Business Plus Membership.

## Distance charge on the route pickup

When the Northgate delivery appointment that delivered the purchase recorded a distance of more than 40 miles, 35.00 is added to the route pickup fee; when it recorded more than 20 and no more than 40 miles, 20.00 is added; otherwise, including a purchase delivered without a Northgate delivery appointment, nothing is added.

The distance read is the one recorded on the Northgate Delivery & Installation appointment linked to the purchase — the appointment that delivered it.

| Distance recorded on the delivering appointment | Added to the route pickup fee |
|---|---|
| more than 40 miles | 35.00 |
| more than 20 miles, up to and including 40 miles | 20.00 |
| 20 miles or less | nothing |
| no Northgate delivery appointment for the purchase | nothing |

## Boundary readings (hypothetical distances)

| Recorded distance | Band | Added |
|---|---|---|
| 40.0 miles | not more than 40 | 20.00 |
| 40.1 miles | more than 40 | 35.00 |
| 20.0 miles | not more than 20 | nothing |
| 20.1 miles | more than 20 | 20.00 |

Both thresholds are strict: exactly 40 miles is in the middle band, and exactly 20 miles adds nothing.
